title: Wiggle Gator (print-in-place articulated)
description: A chunky cartoon gator made of 8 segments joined by vertical-pin hinges that print already assembled; it wiggles side to side like a real tail.
use: Fidget toy and desk pet. Print-in-place: no assembly, but you must snap each joint free once.
material: PLA or PETG, 0.12-0.16 mm layers, no supports, 15% infill, fine bridging settings. Hinge clearances: 0.55 mm radial, 0.6 mm vertical (tested only in software: gap check below). Break joints free by flexing gently.
fit_notes: Print-in-place hinge: pin radius 2.2 in ring hole radius 2.75 (0.55 mm radial), 0.6 mm vertical gaps above/below ring, 0.55-0.6 mm around lobe. See min_gap_between_parts_mm in validation.
